questions.q: What did the man make to reach his bed?
questions.explain: The man needed to make his bed longer to reach it.

questions.q: Where did the man move to after making new furniture?
questions.explain: The man moved to a big forest after making new furniture to help him.

questions.q: What did the man use to eat with after making a long fork?
questions.explain: The man used the new long fork to eat with after making it.

questions.q: What did the man make to fix his too short bed?
questions.explain: Fixing the bed's size by making a longer handle.

questions.q: Where did the very tall man decide to live after making his improvements?
questions.explain: Living in a big forest after improvements.
